title: A Nested Doll-velopement Rerun: Fire Mutant
description: A Nested Doll-velopement Rerun: Fire Mutant — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Kill the Fire Mutant Nesting Dolls to Collect the Fire Mutant Nested Doll in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing B, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 2, then return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Audrey the Alchemist

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill the Fire Mutant Nesting Dolls to Collect the Fire Mutant Nested Doll in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing B, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 2, then return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Offer:

Well, it looks like the Fire Mutant Nested Doll is taking off as a common household knick-knack. Not exactly glamourous but, hey, whatever the customer wants, Audrey the Alchemist provides. I mean these things are bigger than Hurmmels! As long as your logged in and willing I need you to go get me more of the Fire Mutant Nested Dolls.

Head on down to the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing B, located off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 2 in Ratsputin'g Gulag Level 5. When you are there kill the Ice Whisker Nesting Dolls to collect the Ice Whisker Nested Doll. Return to me, Audrey the Alchemist, here in Townston when you are done.

Turn-in:

Excellent! Hand the Nested Doll over to me, I've already got a buyer lined up. Do you want to do this again?

Objectives:

  • Fire Mutant Nested Doll ×1

Client level range: 90–95
